values.note: Booked through Lyon County's Firefly Reservations page. Reservable sites: Lower Campground 1-7, Upper Campground 24-30, Horse Campground 1-5 and 21-22; the rest are not listed as reservable. A 14-day limit on one site, then campers must change sites. No seasonal sites.

note: Lyon County park in bur-oak woodland in the Cottonwood River valley, about 13 mi south of Marshall: Lower and Upper campgrounds plus a separate horse campground (sites marked H on the booking page; any camper may book them). --Claude
summary: County's Firefly booking page: 60 sites (52 electric-only, 8 non-electric; the 52 include the 22-site horse campground), no water/sewer at sites, showers/flush/vault/dump, $25 a night, some sites reservable (rest not listed as reservable). County web pages unread (Akamai 403, Wayback 429); season left as stored (approximate). Not waterfront kept; pin on the campground loop.
